text:
carly (support): Heads-up — customer (acct: acme-inc) reports A/B rollout dashboard for `pricing-bump-experiment` is showing swapped variants and assignment counts that don't match their server logs. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/attachments/exp-swap.png. They're escalating to SEV if this isn't fixed quick.

maria (product): Thanks Carly — can you paste repro steps and whether this is only on prod or also staging? Any idea when it started? :eyes:

carly (support): Repro steps I used: 1) Console -> Experiments -> pricing-bump-experiment. 2) Open the "Assignments" tab and toggle to the last 48h. 3) Dashboard shows Variant A 52%, Variant B 48% but their server-side assignment logs show Variant A 48%, Variant B 52%. Happened since yesterday morning per customer, maybe after the midnight deploy.

ajay (eng-analytics): Can you give me the experiment_id and a sample assignment_event id? Our dashboard query aggregates assignment_events and maps `variant_id` -> label via experiment_versions table. If labels/ordering changed in the latest config migration it could flip mapping.

sam (data): Quick query I ran against prod (sanitized):
```sql
SELECT variant_key, count(*) AS cnt
FROM assignment_events
WHERE experiment_id = 'pricing-bump-experiment'
  AND ts >= '2026-03-10'::timestamptz
  AND ts < '2026-03-13'::timestamptz
GROUP BY variant_key
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```
Results (sample): v2 -> 520, v1 -> 480. But dashboard labels show A=520, B=480 (A/B should map v1->A, v2->B). So looks like the label->variant mapping is reversed in the dashboard layer.

lena (frontend): Frontend uses the experiment_config service to render labels. There's a mapping in UI code that does: `variants = config.variants.map((v,i) => ({ label: labels[i] }))` — if `labels` array is coming from a different source or changed order, index-based mapping will break. We recently merged PR #3421 which adjusted experiment payload shape.

ajay (eng-analytics): That PR changed variant ordering in the config payload (it now sorts by created_at). Dashboard expects stable index-based labels. Root cause hypothesis: index-based label mapping + config payload reorder. Variant keys (v1/v2) are stable in events but UI joins by index. We should join by explicit `variant_key` instead.

kevin (sre): Is this only a UI/dashboard bug (cosmetic) or are assignments actually mis-delivered? Carly?

carly (support): Only dashboard counts mismatch. Customer's product metrics (server-side) confirm assignments delivered correctly. However they're confused and raising tickets, asking for SLA impact.

deploy-bot: Deployed pr/3421 to prod at 2026-03-11T02:15:12Z by @lena.

ajay (eng-analytics): Immediate mitigation: change analytics query to join on explicit `variant_key` (or `variant_id`) rather than array index. Longer-term: modify frontend config contract to include explicit `variant_key`->label mapping.

sam (data): I can run a backfill to recompute dashboard aggregates for the last 7 days. Command I plan to run: `python scripts/backfill_assignments.py --experiment pricing-bump-experiment --start 2026-03-09 --end 2026-03-16 --join-by variant_key --write`

lena (frontend): I'll push a small UI fallback that prefers `variant_key` mapping if present. Patch ready -> merging now. :hammer_and_wrench:

deploy-bot: Started rollout for lena/ui/exp-fallback (canary) at 2026-03-11T15:42:05Z.

lena (frontend): Canary looks good on staging; rolling to prod. This will stop index-based fallback and render labels based on `variant_key` when available.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: lena/ui/exp-fallback -> prod at 2026-03-11T15:54:01Z.

ajay (eng-analytics): I've opened PR to change the dashboard SQL to join on `variant_key` and added a test to ensure label mapping survives config reorders. Going to deploy the fix to analytics tomorrow morning.

sam (data): Backfill scheduled for 2026-03-12T01:00Z (low traffic window). Will post progress and final counts.

kevin (sre): Can we also add a short banner on Experiments page saying "Assignment counts may be inaccurate during config migrations" until backfill completes? Would reduce ticket volume.

maria (product): Yes please. Carly, please draft a short customer-facing message and send to affected customers with estimated fix timeline. Also file SEV and include affected accounts list.

carly (support): On it — will send update and create SEV ticket. Will include steps we took and ETA for backfill.

ajay (eng-analytics): Postmortem items: 1) Fix dashboard join to use explicit keys (in PR). 2) Add contract test for experiment payload shape. 3) Add monitoring alert if dashboard mapping yields >5% divergence from event-store counts. 4) Communicate change log about PR #3421.

maria (product): Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with backfill result and customer replies. We'll schedule a short postmortem meeting after the fix.

carly (support): Backfill finished at 2026-03-12T02:35Z — counts now match server logs. Customer confirmed the dashboard numbers are now correct. Closing for now; PM requested postmortem next week. :white_check_mark:
